ui.Guide_AttackDamageAbilityPower_0: A Traveler's basic attack deals damage equal to their [Attack Damage], while most Memories deal damage based on [Ability Power]. You can check which stat a Memory or Essence scales with by the icons (<sprite=2><sprite=1>) in the tooltip description.
ui.Guide_AttackEffect_0: Some Essences have an [attack effect] that triggers each time the Traveler performs a basic attack. This effect generally doesn't trigger on Memory damage.
ui.Guide_Cold_0: Memories that deal Cold damage apply [Cold] to enemies. Cold slows enemies down.
ui.Guide_CritChance_0: According to this probability, the Traveler's [basic attack] becomes a [Critical Strike], dealing double damage. Damage from Memories is not affected by Critical Strike Chance.
ui.Guide_Dark_0: Memories that deal Dark damage apply [Dark] stacks to enemies. Enemies corrupted by darkness take `DewElementals::DarkDamageAmpPerStack|percent*100` increased damage from Dark damage per stack, and can be stacked up to 5 times.
ui.Guide_EditMode_0:
You can freely change your Memories and Essences at any time through [Edit mode]. To enter Edit mode, press `editSkillHold,editSkillToggle`.

In Edit mode, you can also check the Traveler's stats on the bottom left of the screen.
ui.Guide_Essence_0: [Essences] are mysterious gems you can equip to Memories to give them special effects. These effects are treated as part of that Memory. When you equip multiple Essences to the same Memory, they can interact to create chain effects.
ui.Guide_Fire_0: Memories that deal Fire damage apply stacks of [Fire] to enemies. Fire stacks inflict [Burn] damage over time, scaling with the number of stacks and the enemy's level, and can stack without limit. [Burn] damage doesn't trigger Essences.
ui.Guide_Hunt_0:
The Master of Dreams doesn't welcome outsiders. The monsters he created, known as the [Hunters], will pursue you relentlessly.
These [Hunters] take over adjacent rooms with each movement turn, except the room with the exit. Entering a room occupied by the Hunters is extremely dangerous. [Move quickly!]
ui.Guide_ItemSharing_0: To let others pick up Memories and Essences that have dropped for you, [Share] them by pinging (`ping`) the item. Unequipped Memories and Essences are shared automatically and can be picked up by others.
ui.Guide_Light_0: Memories that deal Light damage apply [Light] stacks to enemies. Enemies exposed to light take `DewElementals::LightDamageAmpPerStack|percent*100` increased damage from Light damage per stack, and can be stacked up to 5 times.
ui.Guide_MeleeBasicAttack_0: The basic attack of a [Melee Traveler] deals area damage, dealing 100% of their Attack Damage to the main target and 50% damage to other targets.
ui.Guide_Merchant_0: You can purchase Memories and Essences from the [Merchant] using Gold, or sell your own Memories and Essences to them.
ui.Guide_MirageSkin_0: Deep in The Rapids, some monsters appear with [Mirage Skin]. Mirage Skin makes them Unstoppable and immune to crowd control effects such as stun and root, while granting special abilities that make them extremely dangerous. Delusion - Reduces healing received by Travelers. Oblivion - Prevents Travelers from casting Memories for a short time. Oppression - Stuns Travelers. Pulverization - Destroys Travelers' shields. Sanctification - Makes nearby monsters immune to damage. The deeper you venture into The Rapids, the more varied and deadly types of Mirage Skin you'll encounter.
ui.Guide_OverCrits_0:
If [Critical Strike Chance] exceeds 100%, the Traveler's basic attacks will always be Critical Strikes and also have a chance to deal even greater additional damage.
For example, with 120% Critical Strike Chance, there is a 20% chance to deal triple damage and an 80% chance to deal double damage. With 220% Critical Strike Chance, there is a 20% chance to deal quadruple damage and an 80% chance to deal triple damage.
ui.Guide_PingsAndEmotes_0:
You can use [Ping](`ping`) monsters, Memories, Essences, and more to alert your teammates.
Press and hold the [Emote] button(`emote`) to open the emote wheel, then hover over the desired emote and release to express your current mood.

On gamepad, tap the assigned button to ping or hold it to use emotes.
ui.Guide_Potions_0:
When you defeat enemies, there is a 2.5% chance they will drop a Health Potion. When collected, all nearby Travelers recover a small amount of Health.

The chance of a Health Potion dropping increases as the Traveler's Health decreases, up to a maximum of 5%. Heroic Bosses and Mini Bosses have a 100% chance to drop a Health Potion.
ui.Guide_Rift_0:
You can use [rifts] to move from your current location to adjacent rooms. Your expedition must defeat enemies and reach each dream's exit to move on to the next one.

Interact with a rift or press `worldMap` to open the Dream Map.
ui.Guide_SkillHaste_0: [Memory Haste] reduces the cooldown of all Memories. For example, if you have 100 Memory Haste, the cooldown will be reduced 100% faster. For Ultimate abilities, it increases the charge speed at the same rate.
ui.Guide_Skill_0: [Memories] are magical recollections that can be used during combat in The Rapids. You can equip, unequip, or swap Memories at any time while in The Rapids.
ui.Guide_Ultimates_0:
[Ultimate Memories] do not have a standard cooldown and can only be used when their charge reaches 100%. The Ultimate charges whenever the Traveler deals or receives damage, and this rate is affected by Memory Haste.
Cooldown reduction effects applied to Ultimates are converted at a rate of 1 second to 1%.
ui.Guide_UniqueMemoriesAndEssences_0: By defeating [Heroic Bosses] and claiming their souls, you can sometimes obtain Memories or Essences that cannot be acquired by any other means.
ui.Guide_Well_0: At the [Well], you can use Dream Dust to empower Memories or Essences. Empowering raises the level of Memories and improves the quality of Essences, making them more powerful.
ui.Hero_Aurena_Description: Aurena is a sage from the Lunar Arcanum Society who was expelled for researching forbidden knowledge. She is a battle healer who dismantles her own life force to wield its power.
ui.Hero_Aurena_Story:
Aurena is a brilliant scholar who studies the mysterious powers of dreams. She discovers and learns to harness the dream power known as "Dismantling Force," but this process involves numerous forbidden experiments.
Though ultimately expelled from the Society, Aurena willingly enters The Rapids to fully unravel the world of dreams.
Aurena believes bringing back perfect knowledge will restore her honor, unaware of the true price she may have to pay.
ui.Hero_Aurena_Subtitle: Expelled Sage of the Lunar Arcanum Society
ui.Hero_Bismuth_Description: Bismuth is the fusion of an empty, nameless spellbook and an ordinary blind girl. She moves swiftly and deals sustained ranged damage.
ui.Hero_Bismuth_Story: When two consciousnesses became one, both the book and the girl disappeared, and Bismuth was born. The girl had always longed to see the world, while the book wished to become the protagonist of its own story. As they entered The Rapids to fulfill each other's wishes, their minds became intertwined, yet their vision has never been clearer. So together, as a new being named Bismuth, they entered The Rapids to write their story.
ui.Hero_Husk_Description: Shell is the perfect instrument of slaughter, incapable of feeling emotion or pain. An assassin who exploits enemy weaknesses with unpredictable movements, eliminating targets in the most efficient way possible.
ui.Hero_Husk_Story: The soul of a once-infamous assassin now resides in a wooden puppet that feels neither emotion nor pain. To him, targets were merely obstacles to be removed, and his blade would find the most efficient path without hesitation. Despite being a perfect tool of slaughter, he is plagued by an unfillable void. He comes to realize that his lost emotions are connected to the world of dreams. In search of his true body and hoping to quench his endless thirst, Shell enters The Rapids, the origin of everything.
ui.Hero_Husk_Subtitle: Manufactured Assassin, Wooden Doll with a Soul
ui.Hero_Lacerta_Description: Lacerta is a former Royal Guard sniper and hunter skilled with firearms and gunpowder. He is used to taking out enemies from a distance.
ui.Hero_Lacerta_Story:
After leaving the Royal Guard, Lacerta settled into life as an ordinary hunter. Several years ago, his wife vanished before his eyes, consumed by blue flames.
Recently, Lacerta uncovered clues linking her disappearance to dreams and the Lucid Sect. He enters The Rapids, determined to find out what happened to his wife.
ui.Hero_Mist_Description: Mist is a brave duelist of noble birth. Her agile fighting style allows her to dodge deadly attacks and quickly take down her enemies.
ui.Hero_Mist_Story:
Mist's younger sister, Astrid, has recently vanished, leaving behind only a letter. In it, Astrid claims she has joined the Lucid Sect, a secret group devoted to dreams.
But Mist is convinced her sister would never make such a choice willingly—she must have been taken. Determined to rescue Astrid, Mist enters The Rapids.
ui.Hero_Nachia_Description: Nachia is a spirit mage of the dream world and guardian of the Ethereal Forest. She can summon spirits that follow her and fight by her side, dealing steady damage.
ui.Hero_Nachia_Story:
The once peaceful Ethereal Forest was transformed into the "Forest of Turbulence" for reasons unknown, forcing its guardian, Nachia, to leave her home. Awakening in an unfamiliar place, Nachia discovered her Memories in pieces. She does not know why she is here or what happened to change the forest.
All that remains are faint connections with spirits, fragmented memories, and a sadness she cannot explain. Nachia now wanders The Rapids, searching for answers about her past and the tragedy that befell her forest.
ui.Hero_Nachia_Subtitle: Spirit Mage of the Dream World, Guardian of the Ethereal Forest
ui.Hero_Vesper_Description: Vesper is the leader of the Order of the Sacred Flame and a ruthless inquisitor. He fights at close range, holding back enemies while dealing heavy damage.
ui.Hero_Vesper_Story:
Vesper, leader of the Order of the Sacred Flame and a devout follower of the sun god El'pyros, seeks to purge all heretics who oppose El'pyros's will.
While raiding an outpost of the Lucid Sect, a group of dream worshippers, Vesper and his subordinates discover a dimensional rift leading to The Rapids.
Seizing the opportunity, he enters The Rapids with his followers, intent on striking down the false god they serve.
But now, his subordinates are nowhere to be found.
ui.Hero_Vesper_Subtitle: Ruthless Inquisitor of the Order of the Sacred Flame
ui.Hero_Yubar_Description: Yubar is a fantastical being born from dreams, a deity who governs the creation and destruction of stars. He uses powerful magic to deal heavy damage from a distance.
ui.Hero_Yubar_Story:
Yubar suddenly awakens somewhere in The Rapids. The immense power he once possessed is gone, and when he reaches out, the stars no longer gather at his command.
Something feels off... and oddly intriguing. Determined to find out why, he sets out to find answers within The Rapids.
ui.Hero_Yubar_Subtitle: Born of Dreams, God of Stars

ui.InGame_Result_Subtitle_GameOver_0: It's okay. This is just a dream.
ui.InGame_Result_Subtitle_GameOver_1: I guess it's not my fault.
ui.InGame_Result_Subtitle_GameOver_3: You'll do better next time, right?
ui.InGame_Result_Subtitle_GameOver_4: If only I had dodged that.
ui.InGame_Result_Subtitle_GameOver_5: Nevertheless, you failed to wake up.
ui.InGame_Result_Subtitle_GameOver_6: The soil in The Rapids has grown more fertile.
ui.InGame_Result_Subtitle_GameOver_7: The Rapids remain at peace today.
ui.InGame_Result_Subtitle_GameOver_Dark_0: In the end, darkness consumed you.
ui.InGame_Result_Subtitle_GameOver_Dark_1: It's so dark, not even a body could be found.
ui.InGame_Result_Subtitle_GameOver_Dark_2: There's nothing left behind those dark eyes.
ui.InGame_Result_Subtitle_GameOver_Fire_1: Whas this your idea of getting a tan?
ui.InGame_Result_Subtitle_GameOver_Hero_Aur: Taking risks always comes with a price.
Your health comes first. Don't push yourself too hard.
ui.InGame_Result_Subtitle_GameOver_Hero_Bis: We always wanted to see the world, but not like this.
The mystical colors slowly faded away from them.
In a place both foreign and familiar, they concluded their story.
ui.InGame_Result_Subtitle_GameOver_Hero_Hus: A servant without purpose has no reason to exist.
It is truly pitiful to not know what to feel even at death's door.
ui.InGame_Result_Subtitle_GameOver_Hero_Lac: Maybe this was just too much for a reptile.
Oh no. I never like seeing animals die.
ui.InGame_Result_Subtitle_GameOver_Hero_Mis: The saber was found nearby, bent like a noodle.
ui.InGame_Result_Subtitle_GameOver_Hero_Nac: Who will feed the dogs now?
As time passed, an undying spring blossomed beneath her staff.
ui.InGame_Result_Subtitle_GameOver_Hero_Ves: Maybe their faith just wasn't enough.
ui.InGame_Result_Subtitle_GameOver_Hero_Yub: Even the god of stars wasn't much, after all.
He once created the stars, but he couldn't save himself.
Perhaps it's okay, since he was never alive to begin with.
ui.InGame_Result_Subtitle_GameOver_Ice_0: You were discovered by a later party, frozen for eternity.
ui.InGame_Result_Subtitle_GameOver_Ice_2: The ground is cold as ice.
ui.InGame_Result_Subtitle_GameOver_Light_0: That's one brilliant way to go.
ui.InGame_Result_Subtitle_GameOver_Light_1: You were shining so bright, I almost didn't realize you were dead.
ui.InGame_Result_Subtitle_GameOver_Light_2: Staring at a bright light too long can make you go blind.
ui.InGame_Result_Subtitle_GameOver_Spider_0: Looks like the local spiders just got their meal for the day.
ui.InGame_Result_Subtitle_GameOver_Spider_1: Less than an hour later, not even your bones remained.
ui.InGame_Result_Subtitle_GameOver_Spider_2: Pretty sure bug spray won't cut it with a spider that size.
ui.InGame_Result_Subtitle_PureWhiteDream: At last, you have achieved what you desired.
ui.InGame_Result_Subtitle_PureWhiteDream_He: I was right all along! Now even the Society won't be able to refute my claims.
Now let's make the world our story. The story of Bismuth!
...I can feel it. Truly... it's been so long since I felt warmth.
Finally... I see you again. Iris. Have you... waited long?
Astrid, I can hear your voice... I was so worried.
Little Belpho, it's been a while. I've missed you. Truly...
The purification of this world does not end here.
Huzzah! Is this the true power of the divine? It suits this form most splendidly!

ui.IntroVideo_Subtitle_00: Long long ago, there lived a man named Primus.
ui.IntroVideo_Subtitle_02: Within the depths of dreams, Primus became the very first god.
ui.IntroVideo_Subtitle_03: But thereafter, the barrier between dreams and reality shattered.
ui.IntroVideo_Subtitle_04: and terrible monsters began pouring forth from the realm between,
ui.IntroVideo_Subtitle_06: Some saw this as a catastrophe. While others saw it as an opportunity.
ui.IntroVideo_Subtitle_07: They say that those who reach the deepest depths of dreams,
ui.IntroVideo_Subtitle_08: can achieve anything their heart desires.
ui.IntroVideo_Subtitle_09: And so, countless beings entered The Rapids,
ui.IntroVideo_Subtitle_10: each grasping their own reasons, and their own purposes.
ui.IntroVideo_Subtitle_11: But these, these are their dreams.
ui.IntroVideo_Subtitle_13: What is your shape of dreams?

ui.Nametag_April_EverlastingAutumn_Descript: A spring scent that lasts forever.
ui.Nametag_Boss_CleverGirl_Description: From the shattered sea of gluttony, a nameless shard emerged. The wounded god saw his own scars in that fragment and forged his regrets into a blade. It's edge, shaped by guilt and tempered by his cruelty, became the most loyal sword. This blade reflects not the uncertain eyes of its master, but only the face of a perfect tyrant.
ui.Nametag_Boss_CorruptedForestKeeper_Descr: His touch was the whisper of azure leaves, a guidepost for the lost. Yet at the tips of broken branches, he bloomed thorns from crimson dreams. Now his forest becomes a trap, its end nothing but hungry brambles.
ui.Nametag_Boss_EmptyFaithBurningHeart_Desc: He was a gentle mountain, embracing his dearest friend, yet beneath his shadow, he harbored the fiery heat of a heart that could melt all things. He turned his own body into an altar and imprisoned himself, raising an illusion from his purest memories. Now, he offers a cup with a smile, and when the cup is empty, he stains the altar with his friend's blood.
ui.Nametag_Boss_FirstChallenger_Description:
He was the first blade to point its edge at the God of Dreams, his blade was the ridge of snow-capped mountains, and his edge was the song of giants.
Yet how could one cleave the anvil that forged the world? The sword shattered into pieces, and his kingdom turned to dust from the shock of its own breaking sound.
Now he is a rusted blade drifting over his own fragments. The first defeat that proves the god's power, and the first courage that proves one can challenge him.
ui.Nametag_Boss_Gluttony_Description:
He was a wise gardener who tended the sky garden, and the blue, cloud-soaked flowers were his only friends.
One day, when sorrowful rain fell and poison seeped into his roots, the gardener became a pest that coveted the flowers.
From the depths of shattered petals, he turned into a swarm of locusts. Even if another hand snapped off parts of him, that vast hunger would only drift on to the next flower bed.
ui.Nametag_Boss_HarmonyDiscord_Description:
His brush is a single, bold stroke soaked with the ink of hope. His movements are the steadfast will that writes new beginnings upon a blank canvas, where every blurred trace is turned into proper letters under the first stroke of the white night.
She is a solid stone, grinding lingering regrets into essence. Her cooling presence brings the scent of ink that calms a restless mind. Every obsession is worn away on the inkstone of a cold moon.
All souls are shaped and written here, each one opening a new chapter. Any creature that disturbs the white rice paper is simply a misplaced drop of ink.
ui.Nametag_Boss_LoveEmbroideredNightSky_Des:
The universe drew her as the brightest star, yet she refused her destined orbit and wished to become a comet forging her own path.
So she cast herself into the black void, breaking her orbit, believing that stealing light from other stars was freedom.
Yet the wandering star knows not that her path is merely spinning, drawn by another gravity.
Nor that the veil of broken starlight still guards her night.
ui.Nametag_Boss_LoveEmbroideredNightSky_Nam: Love Embroidered in the Night Sky
ui.Nametag_Boss_Radiance_Description:
In the days when all spirits knelt beneath his banner and all elements sang of his deeds, the light of his radiant throne knew no dimming.
Yet those radiant days lost their light, and the brand of rebellion was carved upon him. In the ruins of a nameless dimension, he became a ghost that none remember.
Breaking the silence of those ruins, a whisper blooms. The king without a throne gathers his army once more beneath a forgotten banner.
ui.Nametag_Boss_SeekerOfEndlessPower_Descri:
Having drunk from every fountain of knowledge, yet with his thirst unquenched, the sage finally reached the bottom of the well in the abyss.
The pilgrim became a plunderer, learning to steal water from other vessels to moisten his fractured soul.
Drought has dried up all his rivers, and he remains alone, licking the bitter dregs at the bottom of his own vessel.
ui.Nametag_Boss_StarIlluminatingTheQueen_De:
For her, he painted an eternal masterpiece: the night sky. But she, coveting his creation, trapped the artist within his own canvas.
Now the sole admirer, the queen shines alone upon the jet-black paint, drunk on the arrogance that it was all for her.
Yet from behind the canvas, whenever a strange color threatens to stain it, the painter quietly wipes away the blemish with an unseen brushstroke.
ui.Nametag_Boss_StarIlluminatingTheQueen_Na: The Star That Illuminates the Queen
ui.Nametag_Boss_TheFirstDreamer_Description:
The Dream Guardian sings, letting a longed-for voice resound in a room full of silence.
The Dream Tyrant commands, demanding that all the world's noise be quieted for that song.
A human understands that an echo with no reply is only an empty sound.
ui.Nametag_General_EndOfBeginning_Descripti:
Do you remember how the empty canvas was once a dazzling white? It was a perfect silence, a world where nothing existed.
You simply wanted to place a single, tiny dot on that pure world. Something like a familiar face or a faint warmth.
The moment you yearned for a color other than white, atop the tower of shells, you realized the very first dot was actually a smudge.
ui.Nametag_General_PrincessDream_Descriptio:
The princess's palace gleams with a thousand chandeliers shining day and night, a dazzling prison where not even a sliver of shadow is allowed.
So the princess dreams of a single beam of sunlight slipping through old, creaking window frames, casting its glow on a dusty floor.
Those who stand in the brightest place can never hide in darkness. Only when she closes her eyes does she wander, searching for a humble corner somewhere.
ui.Nametag_Heroes_Aurena0_Description: A child born from forgotten ink and a final breath. Solving his incomplete equation was her only purpose.
ui.Nametag_Heroes_Aurena1_Description: They called her boldness heresy, yet the exiled sage finally found the answer: the alchemy of knowledge that turns the lead of ignorance into pure gold.
ui.Nametag_Heroes_Aurena2_Description: She carries yesterday's moon in her heart, holding unfinished gold as she moves forward. She does not realize she herself is scattering into noble dust, the final ingredient for the ultimate transmutation.
ui.Nametag_Heroes_Bismuth0_Description:
One was a crystal lantern, cold for it could not hold light,
The other was a lonely flame, burning alone in darkness with no vessel to contain it.
ui.Nametag_Heroes_Bismuth1_Description:
The flame willingly seeped into the lantern, and the lantern embraced light for the very first time.
The story gained its first sentence, the girl gained her first world—what a perfect exchange.
ui.Nametag_Heroes_Bismuth2_Description:
The flame sees the world only through the lantern's hue, and the lantern exists only through the light trapped within.
United as one, they wander still through the eternal night, illuminating each other.
ui.Nametag_Heroes_Husk0_Description: His soul was a precarious flame, twisted together with sin and warmth. He prayed for this painful light to be extinguished.
ui.Nametag_Heroes_Husk1_Description: As he wished, the flame dimmed, leaving only a handful of cold ashes in his chest. Instead of peace, he found only bitter cold and the complete darkness known to those who have lost their light.
ui.Nametag_Heroes_Husk2_Description: The ashes wear a smiling mask, sinking into the abyss of dreams in search of lost embers. The wood that has turned to ash forgets it can never burn again.
ui.Nametag_Heroes_Lacerta0_Description: His feet always followed the only path he knew: a march of loyalty to his king and faith in his comrades. It was a perfect march without a single misstep.
ui.Nametag_Heroes_Lacerta1_Description: But the map given to him by a nameless stranger showed a path to a unique cabin in an unknown forest, the only one of its kind in the world. For the first time in his life, he stopped his march and chose that path.
ui.Nametag_Heroes_Lacerta2_Description: The map has turned to ashes, leaving him alone on the road. Guided by the afterimage of blue flames, he walks again along the path where his tears have dried, as if it were his very first journey.
ui.Nametag_Heroes_Mist0_Description: The teal vine torn from the fortress wall learned to survive by rooting in nameless crevices, feeding on smiles instead of sunlight and drinking the dew of tempered blades instead of rain.
ui.Nametag_Heroes_Mist1_Description: Now, in a land where those smiles never return and even the stone crevices feel empty, the vine no longer hides.
ui.Nametag_Heroes_Mist2_Description: Covering itself with thorns, the vine crawls into the abyss of dreams to ensnare the world that uprooted it. All this to reclaim the one warmth that once touched its roots.
ui.Nametag_Heroes_Nachia0_Description:
One was the forest's beating heart, and one was the wild lungs that carried its breath.
Their rhythm and breathing wove together, flowing the world's most peaceful song.
ui.Nametag_Heroes_Nachia1_Description:
One day when breath turned poisonous, every song became a cough and every air became venom.
Now the heart beats desperately alone, sealing shut its final vessels.
ui.Nametag_Heroes_Nachia2_Description:
When at last it broke through its own ribs and stepped outside, the heart had forgotten everything.
Carrying only the inexplicable pain felt from where the empty lungs once were.
ui.Nametag_Heroes_Vesper0_Description: His soul was cold iron forged in a smithy devoid of light. He learned to call the hammer blows upon his body a blessing.
ui.Nametag_Heroes_Vesper1_Description: At last he came to worship the great furnace, the sun, leading other soft irons before it. He promised not warmth, but the perfect form that can only be gained after melting away.
ui.Nametag_Heroes_Vesper2_Description: So when another furnace opened its burning mouth to the world, he did not hesitate. To a true believer, questioning the source of the flames is little more than a meaningless luxury.
ui.Nametag_Heroes_Yubar0_Description: His kingdom was perfect, yet it was only a landscape trapped within a mirror. He was simply the most brilliant reflection in it.
ui.Nametag_Heroes_Yubar1_Description: Until one day, a crack appeared in the mirror, and he discovered eyes watching him from the other side.
ui.Nametag_Heroes_Yubar2_Description: So rather than remain an eternal illusion, he shattered the mirror of creation with his own hands and walked upon its fragments. No longer reflected, he became the true hand, the one who gazes into the mirror.

C_MagicSword.memory:
In the quiet dawn,
when I visit the back garden of Highgate Manor,
a memory rises, unbidden.

The cool air of the old training hall, still brushing against my cheek.
My childhood self, casting only the smallest of shadows.
Mother's voice, sharp as frost.

The Teal Blade.
The family sword—strength and pride of House Verdesilver.
Like a steadfast tree, straight and unwavering,
Mother showed me the blade that day.

But my sword could not follow her teachings.
The tip trembled like a leaf dancing in the wind, and my strength flowed away like water.

Isn't it ironic, Mother?
The proud tree you fought so hard to protect has fallen and broken,
while this worthless leaf, scattered by the wind,
is the one that survived.

Now the family's pride is gone, the weight of the tree lifted...
but I have no regrets.

All I wish for now is...
to wield this blade as a nameless mist that has lost its teal,
for the happiness of my younger sibling.

C_MassProtection.memory:
Every time the Moonlight Council convenes, we extend this great barrier. It is a solemn act, signifying that the Society exists solely in the pursuit of truth, under the profound and absolute belief that we must not interfere in any affairs of the outside world.

Lately, however, I have felt a strange dissonance and a cold realization within this absolute silence. This perfect peace so thoroughly erases the cries of countless lives fading away outside, and our "neutrality" is merely a noble privilege gained at the cost of remaining silent before their suffering.

For some reason, I am reminded of that child's face. Aurena. I realize that the logic we used to block her "dangerous" inquiries bears an uncanny resemblance to the logic we now use with this barrier, shutting out the "dangerous" chaos of the world.

Are we truly "protecting" the truth? Or are we merely "protecting" ourselves from everything we have given up trying to understand?

I wonder if this sacred protection ultimately serves not our sublime neutrality, but our deepest cowardice. I still do not know the answer.

L_MentalCorruption.memory:
As I wander through this world, I sometimes meet people who are aware of the dream world. A rare few remember our encounters completely, allowing us to keep connecting again and again.

One day, while speaking with one of them as usual, I noticed the light suddenly fade from their eyes. That empty gaze was fixed on me.

"Is she truly happy here?"

Suddenly, he called out to me with a question.

"Or is she merely a beautiful doll trapped in your perfect cage?"

In that moment, my world shook. A wave of fear froze my heart. As if my anxiety were contagious, everyone around us began to warp, their hidden hatred and fear for each other rising to the surface.

With my power, I erased the source of that corruption, leaving not a single trace behind. Like an illusion, the chaos vanished, and the world slipped back into its false tranquility. But I saw it. In the shadows, something unseen was mocking my deepest self.

No. This utopia is mine. My wife... my family must be real. I cannot lose them again.

I will make sure this never happens again. No cracks, no doubts.

Never again, will I allow it.

U_Hysteria.memory:
The nightmare's corruption was not a sudden event. It seeped in slowly, like poison, through the deep wounds he received while protecting the forest.

First, his horns twisted into demonic shapes, even though they once marked him as a forest guardian. Then came his nails. From hands that once nurtured life, black claws grew, ready to tear everything apart. The warmth and mischievous playfulness in his eyes disappeared, replaced by the red light of a starving beast. It was as if his original purpose was being both denied and mocked.

As his reason faded and pure pain and fury took hold of his body, he let out one final, broken breath.

"Nachia... I'm sorry..."

But those words reached no one, fading away at the very moment the last spark of the being called "Belphomet" was extinguished.

This was both his last cry and the first howl of the nightmare that took over his body.

R_Contempt.memory:
Day 4 in The Rapids.

I finally have a moment to catch my breath and write again. My whole body still aches, and my hands won't stop shaking, but I have to get this down.

A few days ago, with help from the Lucid Sect, I managed to enter this world called The Rapids. To my surprise, the forest was full of mystery and wonder—sunlight danced between the leaves, and I felt for a brief moment as if I'd stepped into a fairytale.

But it didn't take long to realize that this peacefulness was only a fragile illusion. By afternoon, the fog began to settle, and beyond it, we caught sight of something watching us from the mist.

Even now, my hands tremble as I remember. There was a towering, grotesque creature with smoldering red eyes, its jaw twitching in an unnatural rhythm. In the blink of an eye, it was right in front of us.

Everything after that is a blur. I remember running for my life, my lungs about to burst, the screams of my companions, and the awful sound of flesh being torn apart.


I think I'm safe, for now, but I'll never forget the contempt in its eyes as it tore people apart with those long, cruel claws.

- A.

Yet my will remains clear, bright as the morning star. I will draw the path of my own destiny, and I will break these chains.

Until my final breath, I will remain the one who leads the dance of creation and oblivion. For I am the true god of stars.

tips.AllyEffectOff: You can adjust the intensity of ally skill effects in the settings.
tips.Armor:
Armor reduces the damage taken.
For example, a Traveler with 100 Armor takes 50% less damage.
tips.AvoidAttacks: Evading attacks is more important than attacking.
tips.Cold: The Cold effect reduces the Attack Speed and Movement Speed of enemies.
tips.DamageAmp: When you have multiple effects increasing damage and healing, they all apply multiplicatively.
tips.Dark: Enemies corrupted by Dark take 5 % increased Dark damage per stack.
tips.EssenceSynergy:
Essences equipped in the same Memory can trigger and interact with one another.
Experiment to create powerful synergy effects.
tips.Fire:
Memories that deal Fire damage have a chance to apply stacks of Fire to the target.
The Fire effect deals damage over time, with damage increasing as more stacks are applied.
tips.FireNoProc: Fire damage over time can't trigger Essences or other effects.
tips.HealPotion: Defeating monsters has a chance to drop a Health Potion. This chance increases the lower your health is.
tips.Hero_Aurena0: Aurena's favorite food is eel rice bowl.
tips.Hero_Aurena1: Before her dismissal, Aurena had a habit of recruiting exceptional students as research assistants and unwitting experimental subjects.
tips.Hero_Aurena2: Aurena considers most people, with very few exceptions, to be no more than talking snails.
tips.Hero_Aurena3: Despite being expelled from the Society, Aurena still wears the silver brooch symbolizing a Lunar Sage.
tips.Hero_Aurena4: What Aurena despises most is the conservative ethics committee of the Lunar Arcanum Society.
tips.Hero_Aurena5: Aurena became the youngest Lunar Sage in history, but she herself doesn't consider this fact particularly significant.
tips.Hero_Bismuth0: Bismuth perceives all reality as a fairy tale through her books, and acts like a character from those stories.
tips.Hero_Bismuth1: Bismuth's kindness sometimes leads to cruel outcomes. Like filling a hungry wolf's stomach with stones.
tips.Hero_Bismuth2: Sometimes the girl and the book inside Bismuth converse with each other. To others, of course, she just appears to be a strange child talking to herself.
tips.Hero_Bismuth3: Once, Bismuth helped a lonely scarecrow by nailing several live birds to its shoulders to give it friends.
tips.Hero_Bismuth4: Bismuth occasionally detaches pieces of the metallic crystals that have become part of her body to give as gifts or trade for food.
tips.Hero_Bismuth5: When Bismuth drinks warm milk with honey, she looks like nothing more than an ordinary child.
tips.Hero_Husk0: Due to habits from his assassin days, Shell unconsciously touches the hilt of his knife at his waist from time to time.
tips.Hero_Husk1: One of Shell's daily routines is meticulously polishing his masks engraved with various emotions.
tips.Hero_Husk2: Shell deeply dislikes the faint sounds his joints make when he moves, as they remind him that he is no longer human.
tips.Hero_Husk3: Though Shell can no longer remember the taste of his favorite grilled fish, that single memory sometimes causes him to stare endlessly at fish in rivers.
tips.Hero_Husk4: Shell instinctively avoids situations where he might see his reflection, going out of his way to avoid even puddles of rainwater.
tips.Hero_Husk5: Shell considers others' jokes and metaphors to be inefficient forms of speech, unable to understand their emotional context.
tips.Hero_Lacerta0: During his time in the Royal Guard, Lacerta often enjoyed betting beers with his subordinates on shooting contests.
tips.Hero_Lacerta1: Lacerta feels strangely insulted whenever he sees a lizard.
tips.Hero_Lacerta2: Lacerta has a habit of fidgeting with a glass vial containing traces of Iris whenever he rests.
tips.Hero_Lacerta3: In villages around the Hissing Forest, Lacerta is known by the nickname 'Shadow Hunter'.
tips.Hero_Lacerta4: Lacerta still can't bring himself to throw away the art books that Iris cherished, keeping them in his cabin.
tips.Hero_Lacerta5: Lacerta still treasures the shooting journal from his days in the Royal Guard.
tips.Hero_Mist0: Most of the money Mist earns from duels goes toward buying materials for her sister Astrid's blacksmithing work.
tips.Hero_Mist1: Mist often observes the elegant movements of cats and applies them to her swordsmanship.
tips.Hero_Mist2: Tea time with her guardian Camilla Highgate is the only moment when Mist truly relaxes.
tips.Hero_Mist3: Mist finds attending lavish noble parties more difficult than life-or-death duels.
tips.Hero_Mist4: As a child, after grueling training sessions, Mist's greatest pleasure was eating nuts drizzled with sweet honey.
tips.Hero_Mist5: Though typically taciturn, Mist speaks to her sister Astrid with the gentlest voice in the world.
tips.Hero_Nachia0: To Nachia, a single dewdrop on a morning glory at dawn is a finer meal than any feast in the world.
tips.Hero_Nachia1: The Dreamlike Forest that Nachia once protected has now become the Forest of Turbulence, filled with unsettling energy.
tips.Hero_Nachia2: Nachia is benevolent, but her goodness is closer to the order of nature itself, making it difficult to compare with ordinary human morality.
tips.Hero_Nachia3: In the past, Nachia would carve fallen old trees into shapes of spirits or animals and place them throughout the forest.
tips.Hero_Nachia4: Nachia sometimes absently hums an old song she used to sing with her younger brother, before falling into silence.
tips.Hero_Nachia5: Nachia's younger brother still lives in the forest they once shared. Now as a demon who no longer recognizes her.
tips.Hero_Vesper0: When resting, Vesper has the peculiar habit of crushing stones to powder in his hand.
tips.Hero_Vesper1: Vesper firmly believes that his armor, bestowed by the Sun God El'pyros, is the most perfect work of art in this world.
tips.Hero_Vesper2: The conclusion of all Vesper's missions is personally conducting a purification ritual against heretics.
tips.Hero_Vesper3: Vesper surprisingly shows a gentle side when dealing with children.
tips.Hero_Vesper4: Vesper considers failing a mission to be a sin equivalent to betraying the gods.
tips.Hero_Vesper5: Thanks to training even more severe than the torture practiced by the Order, Vesper can endure most pain without flinching.
tips.Hero_Yubar0: Yubar longs for the taste of star cookies he used to enjoy in his former universe.
tips.Hero_Yubar1: Yubar has a habit of mixing poetic expressions into ordinary conversations.
tips.Hero_Yubar2: Rather than despairing over the fact that he was a fictional being, Yubar found himself more intrigued by the new possibilities.
tips.Hero_Yubar3: The particles of light that follow Yubar are small fragments of the Milky Way he once commanded.
tips.Hero_Yubar4: Yubar considers tasting food an artistic pursuit of exploring new cosmic truths.
tips.Hero_Yubar5: Yubar holds complex feelings toward the guide who revealed to him that he was merely a character from a fairy tale.
tips.Light: Enemies exposed to Light take 5 % increased Light damage per stack.
tips.ProcCoefficient:
Memory hit effects are influenced by the hit coefficient of each Memory.
For example, single-target Memories trigger hit effects more powerfully than those dealing area of effect damage over time.
tips.SkillHaste:
Memory Haste reduces the cooldown of all Memories.
For example, with a Memory Haste of 100, cooldowns will be reduced 100% faster.
tips.Startdust: Collect Stardust to purchase souvenirs from special merchants, or buy stars after your journey ends to strengthen your Traveler.

tips.Survival1:

BouquetOfEyes.name: Bouquet of Eyes
BouquetOfEyes.story:
Good grief, it's still slimy...

This belonged to a monster with countless eyes. It was a creature that lived on the edge of nightmares, with power like a natural disaster. Locals of this world called it the "Flower of Eyes." It watched everything with its thousand eyes, then attacked and devoured anyone weak or foreign.

But perhaps because the monster lacked any sense of judgment, it made one terrible mistake—it challenged the ruler of this realm. It was torn to shreds and scattered across the world. Now all that's left is this empty husk in the Forest of Turbulence.

Just one thing makes me wonder though. Every being here comes from someone's imagination or dreams... what kind of troubled mind could have possibly dreamed up something this horrifying?
shortStory: These eyes... they contain such horrible memories.
Ugh, what a disturbing artifact...

EmblemOfSubjugation.name: Token of Servitude
EmblemOfSubjugation.story:
Where did you find this?

This is one of the tokens Lord Primus forced on those who rebelled against him—a brand for anyone who dared defy fate.

Long ago, when Primus declared his dominion and oppression over this world for reasons unknown, someone stood up to him before anyone else dared.

His name was "Skoll." One of the mightiest beings in the dream realm, he threw everything he had against Lord Primus. Their battle reshaped mountains and diverted rivers. But in the end... Primus toyed with him before crushing him completely.

Afterward, Lord Primus gave these humiliating tokens to rebels, forcing them to swear oaths of servitude.

Strange to find one here now. The powerful aura it gives off suggests it's been lying abandoned for ages.

I wonder... could someone be planning to rise up against him again?
shortStory: This aura... Is it from Lord Primus himself?
A token without an owner? That shouldn't be possible.
I can't sense any trace of who this belonged to. This... isn't right.

FirstMerchantsToken.name: First Merchant's Certificate
FirstMerchantsToken.story:
Oh, this warmth... I can sense the Guide's presence in this paper.

It looks like a regular merchant's document, but... something's different. This is... the actual certificate of the very first merchant, "Jonas." What a historical treasure!

Jonas worked with the Guide to discover how to travel between dreams and reality. He was the first to start trading with people from the real world.

Thanks to him, many residents of The Rapids became merchants and began trading with people from reality. This let them absorb the completeness that gold provides and extend their existence.

But here's the interesting part... Jonas earned plenty of gold, but never kept any for himself. For some reason, he gave it all away to ordinary folks and outsiders, trying to resist fading away through sheer willpower instead. The Guide tried to talk him out of it, but he wouldn't budge. Then one day, he simply turned to dream dust and vanished.

It's been ages since he disappeared, but Jonas still lives on in The Rapids. To this day, merchants call themselves and each other "Jonas." It's not just about trading anymore; it means they're carrying hope and possibility, just like he did.

I've always had a soft spot for this story. Many who follow the Guide know it, but there's something genuinely sweet about it that touches me every time.
shortStory: A merchant's certificate... Seems ordinary but it's actually quite special.
Well, look at that. You've brought me a piece of history.

FoolsGold.name: Fool's Gold Coin
FoolsGold.story:
Oh my... it's been an eternity since I've seen one of these!

These days we get human visitors all the time, but back then? Almost no one crossed into The Rapids. I first saw a coin like this when I was barely 100 years old. It came from some ancient human empire. Once they figured out how much us entities of The Rapids loved these coins, they started trading with us.

But now, this coin has... lost its charm. For us dream dwellers, gold holds special significance: it's like the very symbol of existence in this world.

That's why beings here can be so hostile to outsiders, or oddly fixated on trading. Without regularly absorbing the completeness that gold provides, we just fade away.

This poor coin's been here so long that the dream realm has changed it completely. It's basically an artifact now. Unfortunately, there's nothing left of what once made it special...
shortStory: A trading coin... I haven't seen one of these in ages.
This gold coin has completely lost its shine. How tragic to see something once perfect lose its perfection.
The feel of it against my fingers... definitely not like normal gold coins.

ForestHoundSeed.name: Ancient Leaf Hound Egg
ForestHoundSeed.story:
Both a fossil and a living being... The power of dreams works in mysterious ways.

Creatures from dreams almost never become preserved artifacts like this. They simply fade away when their essence runs out, vanishing completely with time unless something truly special happens to them.

A sickly leaf hound mother, separated from her pack, cared for this single egg with complete devotion. Though just a simple creature, she did something impossible: she gradually transformed her body into pure dream energy through sheer willpower.

When her essence finally ran out and her body began to crumble, she sacrificed herself completely. She poured every bit of her remaining power into this egg. There was a bright flash, and afterward, only the egg remained. Filled with pure dream energy, it hasn't decayed despite all these years. Not even a scratch marks its surface.

But the life inside still hasn't awakened. Were fantasy and life always meant to be separate? Or does it just need more time?

This egg shows that even ordinary creatures can be part of extraordinary stories. I'll keep it safe with my other artifacts. Maybe someday, the time will come for this little one.
shortStory: A familiar shape with an unfamiliar hardness to the touch.
I can still sense a faint life force inside this egg.

NightmareCatalyst.name: Nightmare Catalyst
NightmareCatalyst.story:
This artifact shouldn't exist. It never should have been created.

Dreams naturally appear and fade away, but this is different... I can see traces where someone deliberately extracted and concentrated nightmares. The terror and suffering of dozens of people, layered with frightening precision... Even after losing power over time, the horror contained within this object is still overwhelming.

And this isn't all. I'm sensing something larger: a mountain of nightmares, vast as a waterfall, massive as a great peak. Whoever created this wasn't just experimenting or curious. They had a greater purpose.

Traveler, if you ever face the source of this catalyst—whatever place or being it might be—run. Not even the strongest in The Rapids could withstand such an entity, except for Lord Primus himself.
shortStory: This isn't... right.
This is no ordinary artifact... Someone deliberately created this pure horror.
Extreme cold despair... I can feel it in my fingertips whenever I touch this thing.

StarBlossom.name: Star Blossom
StarBlossom.story:
The dream realm holds countless different worlds.

Lands of endless fire, vast meadows under blue skies, realms choked with poison and green mist... even I haven't seen them all, and I collect stories for a living.

At the very edge of our world, there once existed a place blanketed with twinkling stars. They say that rarely, a flower would bloom there with a star nestled in its petals. This is actually my first time seeing a Star Blossom since that realm suddenly vanished.

Things appear and disappear in The Rapids all the time; that's just how this place works. Though this flower seems to have lost its special power, it's still beautiful to behold.
shortStory: Ah, a flower holding starlight within—how beautiful!
I wonder if stars truly shine forever.
Divine petals of the heavens, with colors that refuse to fade with time.

TheStarlitStone.name: The Starlit Stone
TheStarlitStone.story:
A long, long time ago, among the stories I've collected, there was a rumor. It told of how Night devoured its master and rose as a new star from a land that held a river of darkness and the sky itself. A fanciful tale, I know.
At the time, I simply dismissed it as another one of the strange legends the turbulent Rapids are known to spawn...

But this stone... it's a fragment of the very subject of that rumor. No... a fragment of the one who *was* the subject.
It's a remnant from a time before she became the radiant being she is today, shining brilliantly all on her own. A time when someone lovingly engraved starlight upon her body, which held the night itself. For some reason, to hide all traces of it, she shattered herself, crushing her past into fine dust.

But fate is a curious thing, isn't it? To think she would go so far as to chip and carve away at herself to hide her past, only for a single fragment to survive and tell its story.

This familiar energy, this lingering aura...
Ah, I see now.
She usurped her own kingdom out of obedience to Lord Primus.

...And yet, look. The starlight in this fragment hasn't faded one bit. Could it be that the one who engraved it is still alive and well?

If that's the case, how odd. Why has he...
...for all these long years... simply stood by and watched?
shortStory: This seems incredibly old... but its light hasn't faded at all.
How strange. I've never seen this before... yet I feel a faint but familiar energy from it.
Oh my, this stone holds starlight within it. How beautiful!

TomeOfTheSeeker.name: Seeker's Tome
TomeOfTheSeeker.story:
What a disturbing artifact you've found...

This is the Seeker's Tome, once known as the Book of Dark Sin.

The dream world once had a being of exceptional wisdom. He was what you'd call a true seeker, never drawing a line between this world and the one outside. Deep within a cave, he built his private library, compiling discoveries and writing countless volumes.

One day, he turned his attention to gold's perfection... and the permanence of dreams. That's when he found it: another path to immortality.

He discovered how to sustain himself by stealing power from others. Without hesitation, he refined this process, learning to drain energy more efficiently and grow stronger with each victim. It's just one of many books, recording what he learned from countless experiments on both dreamfolk and those from the real world.

It didn't take long for him to grow powerful—stronger than anyone else in the Rapids.

Known as the Dark Mage, he became a terror to weaker beings throughout the realm. It was believed the Guide had defeated him and burned all his books... but by the looks of things, this artifact was still in use not that long ago.

Could he still be alive, somewhere deep in the Cave of Oblivion?
shortStory: The Book of Sin... oddly enough, it bears traces of recent use.
A seeker devoured by his own discoveries—How unpredictable the paths of fate can be.
This unsettling aura... it's the book of someone once held in highest regard.

VoidWhisperer.name: Whispers of the Void
VoidWhisperer.story:
This formless artifact has some very unusual properties.

That familiar feeling... it definitely contains the Guide's power, who crosses between dreams and reality. But something's off. When I follow this energy back to where it began, I feel an uncomfortable sensation in my hands. There's something unpleasant mixed inside it.

Dreams and reality normally have clear boundaries, only connecting through rare rifts that sometimes appear. The Rapids is the bridge between these worlds. But this object has the power to blur those lines...

Whispers... this artifact speaks terrors in the Guide's voice. But the Guide would never create something like this. Someone has deliberately corrupted her power.

This worries me. Lately I've found more and more artifacts whose stories I can't properly read. Someone with twisted intentions is definitely planning something.

Be careful in The Rapids, Traveler.
shortStory: This artifact... my thoughts blur just from touching it.
It feels familiar but... something's not right. There's a dark energy mixed in.
A strange energy... I find it oddly compelling.

WatchersNote.name: Watcher's Records
WatchersNote.story:
These dozens of pages aren't just simple notes or diary entries.

Each page is crammed with rules, theories, and bizarre symbols, evidence of someone desperately trying to uncover the true nature of our world.

The author calls himself the "Watcher." The early pages calmly describe the rules and patterns of The Rapids. But as you read further, you feel growing doubt and fear about this world. By the middle, you can sense emptiness, madness, and even rage in the writing.

Then there's this eye drawing on the final page, and the trembling I sense from it... Is it the fear of someone who faced the truth, or the excitement of revelation? The record wasn't finished. After this unexplained eye drawing, there's nothing more. The story just stops here.

Why did they suddenly stop writing? Did they discover the whole truth, or... did the truth discover them?

I've never seen an artifact quite like this... The story has no ending, but... perhaps that's for the best.
shortStory: I can still feel emotions pouring from this.
Something dark... and intense.
These symbols... Whoever kept these records discovered something.

WeddingRing.name: Ordinary Ring
WeddingRing.story:
Ah, I can sense the Guide's power in this ring!

It looks ordinary, but... it gives off such powerful artifact energy... She must have kept it for a long time. I wonder why she lost it?

She was created by Lord Primus, just like me, but we're different. She might be the most unusual being in the entire dream world.

While everyone else follows someone's imagination and wishes... she made her own purpose: keeping the dream world safe and lasting. That's probably why everyone calls her the Guide.

But for her to lose something she kept close enough to leave such a strong mark? She must be having some kind of trouble.

Normally, I would tell you the story in this artifact, but... I don't know much about her, and the memories in this ring are too faint. Almost like someone deliberately erased them...
shortStory: This ring... I can feel a familiar energy coming from it.
It looks ordinary, but I can sense the power of an artifact...
